Project filt"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ering is not a sandbox: an agent can do the same from the phone as from the computer. Give the right"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" to run tasks only to trusted devices.
- **The invitation is a secret.** The QR code is single-use a"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"nd valid for no more than 15 minutes. Do not publish it, send it to a chat or save it in shared logs"},{"id":"p20s5","text":". Pairing checks the computer's certificate, its validity period, the address and the pinned fingerp"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"rint.
- **Provider keys are not sent to the phone.** Pairing data is protected by Android Keystore a"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"nd excluded from backups. The plugin's private files on Windows are accessible only to the owner of "},{"id":"p20s8","text":"the user account.
- **Revoke a lost phone on the computer.** Signing out of the app locally deletes "},{"id":"p20s9","text":"the pairing data from the phone but does not revoke access on the DSH side.
- **Notifications do not"},{"id":"p20s10","text":" contain the completed answer.** Failure alerts may include a short summary; lock-screen content is "},{"id":"p20s11","text":"private. Chat names use a localized fallback without fetching a transcript. Details.
- **The relay d"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"oes not see chat contents.** It forwards encrypted traffic but sees IP addresses, timing and the amo"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"unt of data transferred."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Do not expose the DSH web port to the outside and do not disable TLS verification. Details are in th"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"e security overview."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **The computer and DSH must stay on.** The phone does not run an agent. One pairing targets one co"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"mputer; the project list considers the first 100 registered projects.
- **This is intentionally a na"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"tive subset, not desktop parity.** Plugin/skill management is not exposed. Action approvals stay on "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"the desktop because there is no verified plugin API for them; they are distinct from answerable agen"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"t questions.
- **Known 0.9.3 limitations.** A very short task can finish before the waiting notifica"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"tion appears; the answer alert still arrives. Answers to agent questions are shown in a block after "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"all messages, not at their place in time. Details.
- **Notifications are best effort, without FCM/Un"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"ifiedPush.** There is no idle service/permanent connection notification or coverage banner. A pendin"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"g phone task still uses an FGS: its notification cannot be guaranteed invisible on all OEMs. Valid w"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"atches/outbox restore after process death and unlocked reboot subject to pairing, permission and OS "},{"id":"p23s11","text":"guards. After force-stop, launch the app manually. Doze, battery saving, offline devices, 24-hour ex"},{"id":"p23s12","text":"piry or eviction from the 32-watch bound can prevent delivery. Exact limits.
- **Offline content is "},{"id":"p23s13","text":"a bounded stale/read-only cache.** At most 8 snapshots, 3500 KiB of serialized snapshot UTF-8, 24-ho"},{"id":"p23s14","text":"ur age, each snapshot at most 2 MiB; the index is bounded separately. Cache is not authorization, co"},{"id":"p23s15","text":"mmand reconciliation or a full archive. Fresh snapshots contain at most 100 messages/2 MiB; older-hi"},{"id":"p23s16","text":"story recovery is bounded to 16 pages/16 MiB. Upstream JSONL currently reads the whole log before th"},{"id":"p23s17","text":"ose limits apply.
- **Updating DSH requires compatibility verification.** Setup may fill the version"},{"id":"p23s18","text":" from `dsh --version`; the runtime plugin checks the configured declaration, not the installed versi"},{"id":"p23s19","text":"on. Only the exact matrix entries are supported.
